thread:
release-bot: Scheduled rollout window: 2026-07-09T22:00Z. Initiating staged router swap for service=edge-proxy, target router:v2. Canary traffic plan attached. PR: https://git.company/repo/edge-router/pulls/412
Maya Chen: ack. I'll run preflight checks and pin v2-20260709 to the rollout group.
Jamie Li: thanks. router team will warm lanes and keep session-affinity for 10m. planned weights: 2%, 10%, 30%, 70%, 100 (5m hold each).
Carlos (oncall): FYI I'll watch p99 and error budget. Abort if p99 latency > 600ms for two consecutive windows or 5xx spike > 2x baseline.
Priya S.: adding release notes snippet and feature-flag toggle in case we need immediate cutover. Link: https://docs.company/internal/releases/edge-2026-07-09
Maya Chen: preflight output: all healthchecks pass on canary hosts, KV cache warm >85%, connection draining configured.
Maya Chen: config to apply (will run via deploy-bot):
```
POST /admin/route-update
{
  "service": "edge-proxy",
  "from": "router:v1",
  "to": "router:v2",
  "steps": [2,10,30,70,100],
  "hold_seconds": 300,
  "session_affinity_seconds": 600
}
```
deploy-bot: Received request: route-update id=rt-20260709-77. Locking config, applying step 1 -> 2% to v2.
Jamie Li: rolling out step 1. Gate checks: no 5xx, p50/p95 within 1.2x baseline.
Carlos (oncall): observed slight increase in p95 (+8%), p99 stable. No 5xx. continuing.
Maya Chen: applying step 2 -> 10%
deploy-bot: step 2 applied. Monitoring for 5m.
Priya S.: flagging that billing-related headers are intact on sampled requests (checked 30 reqs).
Jamie Li: step 3 -> 30% starting. Note: one edge host showed elevated CPU (72%) but below our threshold. draining policy in effect.
Carlos (oncall): p99 climbed to 420ms (baseline 350ms) during step 3 spike for ~45s, then returned. still under abort threshold.
Maya Chen: moving to 70%
deploy-bot: step 4 applied -> 70%. Autobalance in router will rebalance lanes over 90s.
Jamie Li: hold for 5m. also enabling fallback rule to route-cold if error_rate > 1.5%
Carlos (oncall): small blip of 502s (total 6 in 5m), baseline 3. keeping an eye. if 5xx > 10 in 10m we rollback.
Maya Chen: no new anomalies in logs. Dokku health-probe success rate 99.6%.
Priya S.: updating release notes: final traffic cut planned + post-deploy smoke tests.
deploy-bot: step 5 applied -> 100%. router:v2 is now primary for service=edge-proxy. Rolling old v1 to drain state.
Jamie Li: confirm session affinity handoff complete, warm cache stable.
Carlos (oncall): metrics look good: p50/p95/p99 all within SLO. error budget usage minimal. green.
Maya Chen: tagging release as edge-router@v2-20260709 in the repo. Marking rollout as successful.
Priya S.: I've published internal release notes and notified downstream teams.
Maya Chen: quick postmortem notes: consider increasing warm-up window from 5m -> 8m for next time; one host CPU treaded close to threshold.
Jamie Li: noted. will adjust drain thresholds and add an extra warm host in the pool for next rollout.
release-bot: Rollout complete. Closing window. If any regressions, open incident channel #incidents and reference rt-20260709-77. :ok_hand:
